title: Great guide
text: Amazing views, Sergia was brilliant. Just a peaceful place definitely worth a visit.
author: KellyG3711

title: Absolute breath taking...
text: It takes one of a kind to enjoy this kind of adventure. You go with the flow. Private tour with Sergey was wonderful, at our pace, stopped for coffee, short hike up the mountain, found a beautiful breathing taking spot for a quick yoga session, the energy and vibe was right.  I enjoyed the peacefulness of the trip, less tourist visitors so it was much calming. Sergey suggested a very delicious Ukraine restaurant after and we made the stop for a late lunch, and the food there was delicious! Thank you so much for this personal expereince.
author: mizterious

title: That's great.
text: It was a beautifully organized trip. Very nice accompaniment. The place and nature are marvelous. The time spent there left a very vivid and profound impression.
author: G407NZjuliav

title: Great place, great tour guide
text: Beautiful place and a fantastic guide. On time pick up, every detail taken care of. One of the best tour guides we have ever had.
author: Eugene_L

title: was an amazing experience
text:
We visited Sant Miguel waterfall with my family, and it was an amazing experience
! The place is beautiful and peaceful, perfect for a family day trip. Everything was well organized, and the communication with the tour team was excellent. We truly enjoyed every moment!
